title: Crypto checkout added for Pollen
summary:
Pollen gained a crypto checkout, apps gained finer authorization controls, and Play stopped tripping over its balance badge.

NOWPayments checkout was added alongside fiat checkout, with a payment-method choice on Enter. Crypto purchases have a separate balance, while the dashboard shows fiat and crypto Pollen together.

Apps can preselect allowed models, a Pollen budget, expiry and account permissions when sending someone to `/authorize`. New permission-gated endpoints let authorized keys read account profile, balance and usage data.

The Play page now reads the current balance API response and checks that a value exists before formatting it, fixing a crash after login.

highlights.title: Crypto checkout for Pollen
highlights.text: Choose crypto at checkout to buy Pollen. Enter shows your fiat and crypto Pollen together in the paid-balance display.

highlights.title: Account data for authorized apps
highlights.text: Keys with the relevant permissions can read account profile, balance and usage through `/api/account/profile`, `/api/account/balance` and `/api/account/usage`.

highlights.title: Preselect app authorization options
highlights.text: Apps can preselect allowed models, account permissions, a Pollen budget and expiry in the `/authorize` flow.
